Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
mboh...@shout.net wrote:
> The new ruling on votes talks about referendums and political actions.
> What about Blood Hunt votes? Are you allowed to push on these as they are
> not political actions? When do you replace the cards?

Each Methuselah can play only one PA during a Blood Hunt vote to gain
a vote.

Any cards played during a Blood Hunt vote are not replaced until after
the vote is finished.

V:TES rulebook:

20.2. Voting and Diablerie: The Blood Hunt
...
The rules for calling this kind of vote are the same as calling any
other vote, with two exceptions: The Methuselah calling the vote does
not get one free vote (since there isn't a card used), and the vote
cannot be blocked (since calling the vote isn't an action).
...
Note: This vote is not considered an action, so reaction and action
modifier cards cannot be played.
